start.text: You almost trip over it: a four-sided box grater, the kind used for cheese. One corner has been bent into a rough handle shape. Someone put real effort into this. The grating surface catches the torchlight with a menacing shimmer.

choices.text: Pick it up. Unconventional, but you respect the commitment.
Leave it for a true connoisseur.

take.text: It fits your grip surprisingly well. You make a practice swipe through the air. There's a faint whistling sound. Yeah. This'll shred.
